messages:
tess (product): Heads-up: milestone standup flagged cross-cut risk between function-calling API + embeddings dedupe. Tradeoff needed: ship MVP on schedule or include both features and slip. I propose: MVP = core chat/generation + embeddings (no dedupe), v1 = dedupe + function-calling + UX polish. Need buy-in and quick owners.
omar (eng): rough estimate: removing dedupe and function-calling cuts ~6 dev wks from critical path. We can keep a lightweight function-calling shim (sync-only) for partners, but full async/tooling is big.
ravi (eng-ml): dedupe work also touches embeddings cache and offline pipeline. If we drop dedupe from MVP we still need a clear signal to avoid duplicated vectors in some customers. Could add a post-import dedupe job as interim.
soph (solutions): customers in pilot care more about deterministic outputs and auth than dedupe. Many can accept a manual data-clean step for pilot. ACME specifically asked for function call hooks, though.
zoe (design): UX note: function-calling introduces callback UI and developer docs overhead. For MVP we can ship a simple JSON-output mode and mark advanced tooling for v1.
tess (product): Decision strawman: ship MVP on schedule without embeddings dedupe and without full function-calling pipeline; expose a minimal `json-mode` param for early integrators. v1 (T+10 days) includes dedupe pipeline, async function-calls, and full developer docs. Open to alternatives.
omar (eng): need an operational fallback in case we hit high duplicate-rate customers. propose a "brownout" plan: toggle dedupe at tenant-level once pipeline ready; until then monitor duplicate-rate metric and alert at 0.5% threshold. I'll add metric and alert.
ravi (eng-ml): will slice perf tests so we can validate dedupe job on prod-like data. also add an offline idempotency check job: `python tools/emb_dedupe_check.py --sample 100k`.
soph (solutions): I'll draft outreach to pilot customers offering a manual data-clean assistance window. That should keep ACME happy until v1.
tess (product): owners: omar -> brownout toggles + alerts, ravi -> dedupe pipeline + perf tests, zoe -> docs for json-mode + dev examples, soph -> customer comms + pilot offers. I'll update PRD and milestone board.
deploy-bot: deploy 8201 queued for release/mvp-cut. ETA: 02:15 UTC.
omar (eng): also calling out rollback plan: if duplicate-rate >0.5% or error-rate spikes >0.2% we roll back embeddings import path for affected tenant and engage on-call.
tess (product): ok — schedule change: keep original ship date; v1 buffer set to +10 days. action items: update roadmap, add toggle/gating checklist, prep customer comms, and run `emb_dedupe_check` before v1 deploy. I'll follow up in doc thread. :white_check_mark:
